title.narrative: Multisectoral lifesaving and recovery assistance for most at-risk refugees, IDPs and host communities in Oromia, Benishangul and Gambela regions, Ethiopia

description.narrative: Older people (OP) and PwDs have improved access to community and facility-based preventive, curative health care and rehabilitation services.
Persons with specific needs (PSNs) including most at-risk OPs and PwDs have improved access to direct community-based protection support.
Protection of refugees, IDPs and host communities is enhanced through the promotion of peaceful coexistence and capacity building of different actors on the inclusion of PSNs.
The food security and income situation of people with special needs, especially older people and people with disabilities (PwD) is improved.

This project will aim to improve the living conditions of most at-risk refugees, IDPs and host communities in Oromia, gambella and Benishangul-Gumuz through protection, income security, health and food security interventions.
